name: 98607 · Camas, WA
findings: ZIP 98607 (Camas) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98607 (Camas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98607 (Camas) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
